+/**
+ * Removes encryption and error bookkeeping from an entity intended to be created anew.
+ * The entity is mutated and must not subsequently be used for an update.
+ */
+export function removeTechnicalFields<E extends SomeEntity>(entity: E): void {
+	const seen = new WeakSet<object>()
+	const removeFrom = (value: object): void => {
+		if (seen.has(value)) return
+		seen.add(value)
+
+		for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
+			if (key.startsWith("_finalEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_defaultEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_errors")) {
+				delete (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
+			} else {
+				const child = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
+				if (child !== null && typeof child === "object") removeFrom(child)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	removeFrom(entity)
+}
